title: Cycle a seeded six-incident queue without an immediate repeat
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md, docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md and the task sourceRefs before editing. This is an independent leaf in the B001–B100 cohort, not an integration or completed feature claim. Implement only the owned source and tests, using the exact pinned API section in PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS. No imports from unmerged A/B modules, no manifests/barrels/App.tsx/shared task metadata edits and no new dependencies. Locally declare the contract's shared structural types; package engine/protocol production stays ES2022-only and pure, with no Firebase, browser, Node, UI, credentials, wall clock or global randomness. Use existing deterministic engine RNG only where the contract permits. Never turn a trusted verifier input into a claim of cryptographic verification. Unspecified rules remain explicit named decision-required results; no worker invents policies. Preserve existing T01–T10 API/tests. Run scoped lint/typecheck/tests, then node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full. Return a handoff with paths, API, actual checks, benchmark receipt references and limitations. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, deployment, credential access, task-issue mutation or budget changes. Implement nextIncident exactly as frozen in section B059 of docs/PILOT100_DOMAIN_CONTRACTS.md. Consume a nonempty unique remaining queue as supplied. When empty, Fisher–Yates shuffle all six using existing nextRandom, then if first equals previous swap with the next entry. That swap consumes no extra randomness. Previous is trusted authority history, never exposed as a seed; no copied policy-card deck.
acceptance: Each fresh cycle yields all six incidents once and a second cycle cannot immediately repeat its predecessor.
A nonempty queue consumes its head without RNG advancement and retains remaining order.
A replay matches exact queue/RNG; reject invalid IDs, duplicate remaining entries, invalid RNG and a head equal to previous.
The exported implementation matches the frozen local structural API, preserves legacy APIs, and changes only declared ownership; no unresolved rule is silently decided.

Scoped lint, typecheck and meaningful tests pass, followed by node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; handoff records actual outcomes and receipt references without claiming App/provider integration.
